headline: Archipelago saves remember their room; Blarg Station landing fixed
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0 remembers which room belongs to each save slot and refuses saves from another seed, with reconnect and logic fixes also merged. Difficulty v1.2.4 keeps Blarg Station's ship and Clank from disappearing when enemy count is set to 2: that level now receives no extra copies. Item Randomizer v1.0.4 was also released; all three releases were built against Mod SDK 1.11.0.
highlights: Archipelago's save isolation was checked in the game with two rooms: the correct save was accepted and the other room received no checks (#26).
Logic fixes cover the Pilot's Helmet for the O2 Mask, Hoverboard for the Hologuise and Trespasser requirements near gold-bolt warp pads (#24).
Issue #25 asks players to test Archipelago or Item Randomizer logic, including Trespasser-free access on return Veldin, Aridia and Batalia.
Publishing now rebuilds the index after releases; listing checks explain broken newest releases, and submissions record AI assistance per mod (#27, #32, #33).
Co-op #22 remains an unmerged draft, including proposed PAL/NTSC parties, separate co-op saves and host takeover.
